_doc: The Boki summon (KinSummon, decision 0039): [window s, cooldown s] by the species' ai.role and body.size (briefs/boki-art/WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q1). Uptime = window / (window + cooldown) stays in uptime_band.
_home_doc: A summoned Boki that is killed: its wisp flies home to a hunter who is up at home_mps m/s, showing them through walls for home_reveal_s s (KinSummon.knocked).

steal._doc: Stolen Boki wisps (KinSteal, decision 0041, WISP_DESIGN_OPEN.md Q6/Q8): loose_s = s a downed hunter's wisp floats loose; grab_r = m reach, grab_s = s holding interact; carry_max = stolen wisps one hunter carries; passive_k = share of each stolen carry passive; summon_k = share of its window for the one stolen summon, at least summon_min_s s.
